[[File:Area_D-7s1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Area D-7s1]]
'''Area D-7s1''' was an area of space in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. It was home to the [[Detritus Satellites]], sentient [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'']] droid scavengers that had built a makeshift outpost in this area with scraps from a nearby junk field.
